sections.title: Integrated, Turnkey Energy Solutions
paragraphs: Domus Zero manages your solar PV, heat pump and battery storage project from initial assessment through installation and ongoing support.
items: Assessment of your property and development of a tailored solar PV, battery storage and heat pump solution
Coordination with your Comune and local electricity provider
Integrated design and installation of solar PV, battery storage and heat pump systems
High-quality, efficient and reliable equipment selected for your property
Clear project planning and fixed-price proposals
Management of permits, administration and removal of replaced equipment
Installation planned to minimize disruption to your home or agriturismo
Optional ongoing maintenance and support after installation
